## Swift Agent Kit integration

Use the live Xcode MCP schema as the contract when it differs from an historical example below. In Xcode 27 headless mode, String Catalog tools accept an optional `workspaceIdentifier` (a workspace handle or absolute path) in place of `tabIdentifier`. Carry that selector into delegated translation work and consult `xcode-tools` for current service setup and approval behavior.

device-interaction:
## Swift Agent Kit integration

Use the live Xcode MCP schema as the contract when it differs from an historical example below. In Xcode 27, the project-aware session path is `DeviceInteractionStartWorkspaceSession`; live synthesis is `DeviceInteractionSynthesize` and its session field is spelled `interactSessionKey`. Consult `xcode-tools` for workspace selection and current service setup.
